name: The Thirteenth House
source:
Something sinister brews in the esteemed halls of Arthur Hawthorne University, but first, you need to find a way to fit in with the rich and famous.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Thirteenth_House]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
亚瑟霍桑大学受人尊敬的大厅里正在酝酿着一些险恶的事情，但首先，你需要找到一种与富人和名人打交道的方法。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Thirteenth_House]Choices Wikia[/url]]
